chats.answer:
The VIOFO A329S 2CH is my pick for the best overall two-channel dash cam in 2026, assuming you want front-and-rear coverage. It records 4K up front and 2K behind, performs well in low light, and has better parking-mode and storage options than most competitors. Both Car and Driver and independent tester Vortex Radar rate it their top overall dash cam. 
Car and Driver
+1

If you're paying for it yourself, though, I'd compare these three:

Best overall

VIOFO A329S 2CH

$469.99

VIOFO

4K/60fps front, 2K rear, fast Wi-Fi 6 transfers, and low-power parking mode. Front HDR requires switching to 30fps. No cloud access.

Best balance of price and quality

VIOFO A229 Pro 2CH

$349.99

VIOFO

4K front and 2K rear, using the same image sensors as the A329S. My choice if you mainly need clear accident evidence and don't need the premium features.

Best value

VIOFO A229 Plus 2CH

$229.99

VIOFO

2K front and rear with Sony STARVIS 2 sensors and HDR. Excellent everyday coverage for substantially less money.

The comparison is based on published hands-on testing, not my own testing. Prices above are manufacturer listings; discounts elsewhere may change which is the better buy. 
Vortex Radar
+1

Two things worth budgeting for: a compatible high-endurance microSD card, preferably 256GB or 512GB, and a hardwire kit with low-voltage cutoff if you want recording while parked. Even the best 4K camera cannot reliably capture every moving license plate at night.

Bottom line: Get the A329S if you want the best. Get the A229 Pro if you want the smarter purchase for ordinary driving.

What I'd actually buy

For everyday accident evidence, I'd choose the A229 Pro if it's substantially cheaper than the A329S. The premium model's biggest advantages are faster transfers, storage flexibility and parking features—not a dramatic leap in basic image quality.

Budget for a compatible high-endurance microSD card and, if you want recording while parked, a hardwire kit with low-voltage protection. No dash cam can reliably capture every moving license plate at night, even at 4K.
